newsitem.title: TURKEY: Sixteen dead, nine abducted in Turk-Kurd conflict.
newsitem.headline: Sixteen dead, nine abducted in Turk-Kurd conflict.

text.p: Turkish security forces killed 15 Kurdish guerrillas and one soldier died in a clash on Monday in the mountainous southeast of the country, security officials said.
Three soldier were also wounded in the clash with Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels, which took place in rugged terrain in the provinces of Batman and Mardin, they said.
Separately, PKK guerrillas abducted eight villagers and a member of a pro-state, anti-rebel militia at the weekend in Diyarbakir province, the officials said.
More than 22,000 people have died in the conflict between troops and the PKK rebels who have been fighting for autonomy or independence in the mainly-Kurdish southeast since 1984.
